signature.description: A signature over the record's DAG-CBOR encoding with its 'signature' field removed. ECDSA over SHA-256, 64-byte compact low-S, as used for ATProto commits.

key.description: The signing key as a did:key (P-256 or K-256).

nodeKeys.description: The public keys of one node.

signingKey.description: Signs the node's declaration and relay requests. Also the node's ID.

signalKey.description: X25519 public key used to seal signals to this node. Separate from the WireGuard key.

nodeId.description: A node's ID: the did:key of its signing key (P-256 or K-256).

ipv4.description: An IPv4 address in dotted-decimal form, e.g. '100.80.0.5'.

ipv4Prefix.description: An IPv4 prefix in CIDR form, e.g. '100.80.0.0/16'.

ipv6Prefix.description: An IPv6 prefix in CIDR form, e.g. 'fd5e:7a11:9c04::/96'.

ipAddress.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address in text form.
